facts.fact: The president of Benin's data protection authority (APDP) said the Code numerique requires critical servers to be sited on national territory and called for its rigorous application.
Luciano Hounkponou spoke as president of Benin's Autorite de protection des donnees a caractere personnel (APDP) at a panel at ADEX 2026.
